title: Evaluation of a multiplication gate
statement: Let $F$ be a field with decidable equality, let $\iota$ be an input-index type, let $d\in\mathbb N$, let $R$ be a degree-$d$ resharer, and let $A$ be a finite set of parties. For every party-indexed input assignment $\mathrm{inp}$ and circuits $a,b$, the BGW evaluation of their product circuit is the degree reduction of the pointwise product of their BGW evaluations.
hypotheses_covered: A is a finite set of parties
inp is a party-indexed input assignment
a and b are arithmetic circuits
replaced:
Let $F$ be a field, let $\iota$ be a type, let $R$ be a resharer, and let $A$ be a
finite set of parties. For any input assignment and circuits $a,b$, the evaluation of
the circuit multiplying $a$ and $b$ is the degree-reduced product of their evaluations.
